preservation.interpretation: Application image region varies from the earlier session; frozen original and current runners produce identical captures now. All other pixels/captures match.

coexistence.meaning: Existing Vapor overlay leaves plain VGUI2 GTK apps unchanged; no VGUI2 Adw profile implemented.

existing_suites.vapor_gtk4_adw: PASS; native, Widget Factory, coexistence, 22 Adw cases, 28 activation/recovery tests, 15 bad profiles, eight staging tests.
existing_suites.gtk3: Historical initial-port result: both families and 23 VGUI regressions passed. This GTK 4 audit verified GTK 3 production files/tools unchanged; no full GTK 3 rerun.

diagnostics.timing_control: Both permitted exact Broadway frame-timing strings reproduced on stock GTK with no project CSS; retained in work log and local control evidence.
diagnostics.strict_mode: State checker --strict rejects the reproduced timing warnings too.

limits: No VGUI2 libadwaita profile or shared activation implementation.
No release/AUR update or live activation.
Actual integer scale-2 windows are covered; live fractional scaling, full keyboard/accessibility, broader app workflows, Flatpak and performance benchmarks remain open.

findings_fixed: VGUI4-R3 column/cell separators and minimum-width padding
VGUI4-R4 expander glyphs, RTL and title focus

verification.actual_dark_entry_marker: Required in dark runs and absent in normal runs; verified in all three test paths.
verification.selection_method: Separate actual selections with painted fill and multi-column solid ink checks; avoids primary-selection interference.
verification.expander_focus_method: Paired actual title widgets with one synthetic focused state; native GTK snapshots composited onto the real parent fill; not full keyboard navigation.
verification.frame_edge_method: CSS border widths plus actual painted color and >=245 alpha on the antialiased outside edge.
verification.frame_transport: Audit client acknowledgements paced to 60 per second; other clients unchanged.

limits: No VGUI2 Adw profile/shared activation, package publication or live activation.
Full keyboard/accessibility and live fractional scaling remain open.
